Good work! Very well put together. Just a few pointers that most new users don't know. The first time that a subject is mentioned in an article, it should be bolded. Also, if a page is going to be categorized in a sub-category, it doesn't need to be in the parent category as well. Please don't take this in a bad way. Just want to let you know of a few thing. Again, great work and congratulations on creating your first article! ---- {{User:Mainphramephreak/Sig/Subst}} 06:57, December 16, 2011 (UTC)
